name: Kitsu 漫画
author: MoeGame
licenseNote: Self-authored rule. Kitsu manga catalog via its public JSON:API. Metadata source, no image server.
search: function search(kw, page) { try { var p = page || 1; var url = 'https://kitsu.io/api/edge/manga?filter[text]=' + encodeURIComponent(kw) + '&page[limit]=20&page[offset]=' + ((p - 1) * 20); return fetch(url, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.api+json' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var data = JSON.parse(r.body); var list = data.data || []; return list.map(function(it) { var attrs = it.attributes || {}; return { title: attrs.canonicalTitle || '', url: 'https://kitsu.io/manga/' + it.id, cover: (attrs.posterImage && (attrs.posterImage.original || attrs.posterImage.medium)) || '', extra: { id: it.id } }; }); }).catch(function(e) { throw new Error('kitsu-manga search: ' + e.message); }); } catch (e) { throw new Error('kitsu-manga search: ' + e.message); } }
detail: function detail(url) { try { var m = /kitsu\.io\/manga\/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/.exec(url || ''); if (!m) return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var id = m[1]; return fetch('https://kitsu.io/api/edge/manga/' + id, { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.api+json' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; var d = JSON.parse(r.body); var a = d.data && d.data.attributes; if (!a) return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; return { title: a.canonicalTitle || id, cover: (a.posterImage && (a.posterImage.original || a.posterImage.medium)) || null, description: a.synopsis || null, extra: {} }; }).catch(function() { return { title: id, cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; }); } catch (e) { return { title: '未知', cover: null, description: null, extra: {} }; } }
chapter: function chapter(detailUrl) { try { var m = /kitsu\.io\/manga\/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/.exec(detailUrl || ''); if (!m) return []; var id = m[1]; return fetch('https://kitsu.io/api/edge/manga/' + id + '/chapters?page[limit]=200', { headers: { 'Accept': 'application/vnd.api+json' } }).then(function(r) { if (r.status !== 200) return []; var d = JSON.parse(r.body); var list = d.data || []; return list.map(function(ch, i) { var a = ch.attributes || {}; return { id: ch.id, title: a.canonicalTitle || ('第' + (a.number || '') + '话'), url: 'https://kitsu.io/manga/' + id + '/chapters/' + ch.id, index: a.number || (i + 1) }; }); }).catch(function() { return []; }); } catch (e) { return []; } }
parse: function parse(chapterUrl) { try { return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; } catch (e) { return { urls: [], kind: 'images' }; } }
